title: All About a Spiky Animal
note: b417 — Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — non-fiction, real facts about hedgehogs (the word "hedgehog" is not yet decodable: the "dge" spelling is not taught in this programme).

pages.brief: A garden with bare branches and fallen leaves, a chilly autumn feel to the light.
Moss the hedgehog peering through a pile of fallen leaves, spotting a wild hedgehog settling in.
A close-up of the wild hedgehog’s back, covered in rows of sharp brown spikes.
The wild hedgehog munching on a beetle, building up its food store before the cold months.
The hedgehog nudging its way into a thick pile of dry leaves and twigs.
The hedgehog curled up completely into a tight, spiky ball shape.
The curled-up hedgehog resting still and quiet, tucked deep inside the leaf pile.
A snowy garden scene outside, with the hedgehog still snug and hidden under its leaf pile.
The hedgehog uncurling and stretching, waking up as spring sunlight warms the garden.
Moss the hedgehog and the wild hedgehog standing together in the bright spring garden.
